verdict.rationale: Stripe ships a well-documented, independently probed official hosted MCP server (mcp.stripe.com) exposing API tools, analytics, and knowledge-base search, with OAuth-based auth/governance, human-confirmation for write actions, and connected-account support; a live probe confirms the OAuth-gated endpoint is real and functioning. Missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on review of actual agent usage beyond Stripe's own docs/probes.
